caption: The drawing features a yellow background with brown, green, and pink shading and outlines. At the bottom of the composition, there is a train consisting of four cars: an engine at the right with a steam funnel emitting smoke, a central passenger car with curtains on the windows, a cargo car loaded with round objects, and another boxcar with bars. The train cars are connected and have large spoked wheels. Near the train, to the right, a woman in a pink dress holds a white parasol, alongside a man in a green suit, and a small child in a pink outfit. In the middle and top part of the drawing, there are rolling green and brown hills, with a winding yellow path. On the left hill is a pink house with dark red roof and white windows, while on the right hill stands a small round pink building with a domed roof and windows. Several stylized green and brown trees with round canopies are scattered across the landscape, including a large tree with a pink trunk and green foliage left of center. Small plants, tufts of grass, and dotted details fill the foreground and midground. The entire scene is composed in a flat, decorative style, with solid, bright colors and simple patterns.
title: Bandbox
